title: React useEffect running infinitely
description: My useEffect hook is causing an infinite loop when fetching data. I have added dependencies but it still loops. Can someone explain why this is happening?

solutions.text: Make sure your dependency array isn't containing an object or array that is re-created on every render. If you are defining an object inside the component, it gets a new reference every render!

title: MongoDB aggregation pipeline optimization
description: My pipeline is too slow. I'm grouping by author and then sorting, but it takes 5 seconds on 1M records. Any tips on indexing?

solutions.text: Ensure that your $match stage is the very first stage in the pipeline so it can utilize the index. If you sort or group first, it has to scan the whole collection.

title: How to center a div in Tailwind?
description: I know flexbox works but what is the exact Tailwind utility classes to just perfectly center a child div?

solutions.text: Use `flex items-center justify-center` on the parent container! Alternatively, `grid place-items-center` is even shorter.
